answer: Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so replaying a good answer costs a new signed slot. Reviewers stake quartz on every verdict and a random spot check re-runs one task in twenty; a wrong pass burns the stake. If the panel shares a recruiter the verdict is voided. The number: 3 independent reviewers plus 1 replay, so faking one task costs four stakes. A bad identity burns to an ember in the copper ledger within one epoch.
